inv.desc_en:
Fantastic commercial premises with two entrances at street level, located on C/Casp with C/Roger de Llúria, very close to the Plaça Catalunya-Passeig de Gràcia commercial and business hub, one of the most emblematic areas of Barcelona.Located in a royal estate built in 1900.
Composed of a large useful area on the open-plan ground floor of 917 m2 and a basement of 152 m2.Previously rented to Caprabo.Currently the premises are empty, open plan, with high ceilings, flexible distribution and are in very good condition both structurally and in terms of facilities.
Possibility of smoke outlet
